notes.title: Birthday Update - Animal Planner v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi! It's been a year since the release of Animal Planner!

Update v1.1.0 for Animal Planner is available now across Windows and MacOS on Steam. To celebrate we've also launched a discount for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Acram/sale/turn-basedcarnival2024]Turn-Based Carnival 2024[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479960/Animal_Planner/

[h3]Major Change:
[/h3]
Animal Sounds! Which means when you click an animal in a game level, they will make a unique and funny sound! This new feature makes each level more like a music toy box!!! It's really fun and satisfying to interact with your cute animal friends! 

[h3]Patch Notes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animal SFX: each animal will make a unique and funny sound when you click them.
[*] Camera Adjustment: the chessboard takes more space of the screen in each level.
[*] New Languages: Spanish (Spain), German.
[*] Bug Fix: BGM transition bug.
[*] Bug Fix: level button locating on the level map.
[*] Bug Fix: bomb execution order.
[/list]
Hope you enjoy the game, thanks for all the support during the 1st year of Animal Planner!

Cheers,
Chao from PawPaw Games
